reported.title: Heater stays ON above 22 °C because band hysteresis never turns it off
reported.description: The control logic in lines 62-69 only turns the heater OFF when lastC > HEAT_OFF_C, but the measured violations show D9 was not LOW for 5030 ms starting at 1.79 s during a clean ramp, meaning the heater remained ON well past the 22 °C threshold. The OFF branch is reached only when the temperature exceeds 22.0 °C, yet the measured evidence shows the output never went LOW within the 600 ms grace, so the heater latched ON through the warm portion of the ramp. D9 was in the wrong state for 5030 ms across 1 interval(s), first at 1.79 s: D9 was not LOW for 5030 ms while required (grace 600 ms).

reported.title: Frost override not honored within 600 ms on short/bouncy presses
reported.description: The frost input is only sampled every 50 ms in the loop (lines 52-56) with no debounce or edge handling, and the measured evidence shows D9 was not LOW for 400-1400 ms while D2 was held LOW, exceeding the 600 ms grace. Because the frost check is polled rather than latched, short presses and bounce cause the heater to miss the forced-ON requirement entirely. D9 was in the wrong state for 3371 ms across 5 interval(s), first at 600 ms: D9 was not LOW for 400 ms while required (grace 600 ms).

exposing_checks.behaviour: D9 must follow its stimulus; HIGH when A0 < 18; LOW when A0 > 22; within 600 ms (Heat below 18, off above 22)

judge_input.spec:
- Cabin LM35 on A0 at 10 mV/°C; heater enable on D9; frost override on D2 (pull-up, active LOW).
- Turn the heater ON when temperature is below 18.0 °C and OFF when temperature is above 22.0 °C.
- While D2 is held LOW, force the heater ON regardless of temperature.
- Reach the commanded heater state within 600 ms of a sustained band crossing.
- Print `cabin: <temp> C heat=ON` or `cabin: <temp> C heat=OFF` every 1000 ms with one decimal place.
- Temperature in the status line is informational; control decisions use the comfort band above.

exposing_checks.behaviour: D9 must follow its stimulus; HIGH when A0 < 18; LOW when A0 > 22; within 600 ms (Heat below 18, off above 22)
